product: Clorox Plus Tilex Mold & Mildew Remover
capturedBy: Claude Opus 4.7 via WebSearch + published reviews

keyClaims.claim: Sodium hypochlorite (chlorine bleach) active ingredient at ~1-5% concentration with surfactants; kills 99.9% of common household bacteria per Clorox
Colored-grout WARNING: 'Colored grout may lighten unevenly. Always test an inconspicuous area first if you are unsure about compatibility.'
Chlorine-bleach-on-grout general caveat: 'if your grout is colored, bleach can strip away the pigment, leaving it faded or uneven'
Home Depot reviews (3,500+): 'highly effective in removing mold and mildew with minimal scrubbing required'
Walmart reviews: 'This is the only product that removed the mold and mildew from the grout in some showers, and it worked where other products failed'
Usage pattern: spray, let soak ~5 minutes, light scrub as needed, rinse
Strong-bleach-smell caveat: 'use in a well-ventilated area and wear gloves'
Safe surfaces: 'glazed and unglazed ceramic tile, grout, vinyl, fiberglass, and plastic'
